tei:div.tei:p: (595)༄༅// drags pa'i sde dpon gyi gsol mchod zhugs so/ (596)

drag sngags po lnga ba'i mjug tu/ badzra sarba duṣṭaṃ ye dza bhyo/ sha truṃ har thuṃ dza mā ra ya rbad/ ma hā de wa ṭe u ma de wa e/ ya ma ra wa/ ma ma tan ti ya/ ma ma ru lu ma/ e ka tsa ti tra/ dun khrag du/ dunting du/ rā tsa tsa/ ging ka ra tri/ badzra sa dhu tri/ rā hu la sa/ raksha ra/ rakmo ra/ yaksha ksha/ ma hā kā li kshiṃ/ ru tra mu mun pa/ tir ti ka tha/ de wa a ape la a/ tiṣṇa dri ru tsa/ a si shu kū/ tri pa sa li tri/ byi na ye ka u/ ṭa ki ni maṃ/ nā ga phu/ nā ga kro ti shwa ri phu/ sarba duṣṭaṃ/ hring hring dzaḥdzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis ri rab 'dod yon sna (597)tshogs su bsam/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ dbang phyug che sogs lha srin sde brgyad la/ rnam dag bdud razi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ mthu rtsal drag gapo'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ 'dod don rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma dag*/ las ngan nyams pa bsgral ba'i rakta dang*/ dug gsum rnam dag sha khrag rus pa'-i tshogs/ dregs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul/ dgro bo gdug pa bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol/ lha rin sde brgyad khyed rnams mchod pa'i dam tshan ni/ dkar dmar logs kha dog bye brag rnams/ lha srin sde brgyad sku la mchod pa 'bul/ snyan dang mi snyan sgra yi bye brag ni/ lha srin sde brgyad gsung la mchod pa 'bul/ tsirta smug po rda ltar spungs pa yang*/ lha srin sde brgyad (598)thugs la mchod pa 'bul/ sku gsung thugs kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ sgrol ging pho mos las rnams grub par mdzod// lha srin sde brgyad 'dir byon sha la rol/ dam nyams dgra bo'i sha ni zan bas zhim/ lha srin sde brgyada'adir bon khrag la rol/ dam nyams dgra bo'i khag ni chang bas zhim/ lha srin sde brgyada'adir byon rus la rol/ dam nyams dgra bo'i rus ni mar bas zhim/ lha srin sde brgyad rnams la dug gsum mchod pa 'bul/

dug gsum bzhes la dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol/ oṃ ma hā de wa e u ma de wa e sde dpon sum cu'i zal du ma hā ba li8 ta khā hi/ ma hā pañtsa= ma hā rakta= oṃ āha'uṃ sa ma ya a mṛ ta khā hi/ snying ne bran pho bran mo'i tshogs/ dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya/ bdag gi srung mar mnga' gsol lo/ sangs rgyas bstan pa khyod kyis srungs/ dkon mchog dbu 'apang khyod kyis bstod/ rnal 'byor sku dgra khyod kyis sgrol/ hūṃ/ bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba/ snang rid dregs pa'i ded dpon bzhengs/ dbang phyug ma hā de wa dang*/ btsun mo u ma de war bcas (599)'dod don mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba/ snang srid dregs pa'i ded dpon bzhengs/ 'chi bdag ya ma rā tsa dag*/ skye 'gro'i srog gi bdag mo gnyis/ 'dod don mchod gtor 'di shes la/ bcol ba'i phrin las= hūm̐/ bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba/ snang sri dregs pa'i ded dpon bzhengs/ ma mo sri pa'i rgyal mo dang*/ sngags srung e ka dza ṭir bcas/ 'dod don= bcol ba'i= hūṃ: bkra shis dam ldan mthu ce ba/ snang sri dregs pa'i de dpon bzhengs/ bdud pho skos rje drang dkar dang*/ bdud mo nag mo re ti bcas/ 'dod don= bcol ba'i= hūṃ bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba/ snang sri dregs pa'i de dpon bzhengs/ bdud pho skos rjai drang dkar dang*/ bdud mo nag mo re ti bcas/ 'dod don = bcol ba'i= hūṃ: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba/ snang srid dregs pa'i ded dpon bzhengs/ skyes mchog rdo rje legs pa dang*/ gza' bdud chen po rā hu la/ 'dod don= bcol ba'i= hūṃ/ bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba/ snang srid dregs pa'i ded dpon bzhengs// rgyal po chen po pe har dang*/ srog bdag tshangs pa dkar po bcas/ 'dod don= bcol ba'i= hūṃ: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba/ snang srid dregs pa'i de dpon bzhengs/

skyes mchog rdo rjelegs pa dang*/ gza' bdud chen po rā hu la/ 'dod don= bcol ba'i= hūṃ: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba/ snang (600)sird dregs pa'i ded dpon bzhengs/ srin po nag po glog phreng dang*/ srin mo sbal mgo khrag mig bcas/ 'dod don= bcol ba'i= hūṃ: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba/ snang srid dregs pa'i de dpon bzhengs/ gnod 'dzin yaksha me dbal dang*/ gnod sbyin mon mo nag mo bcas/ 'dod don= bcol ba'i= hūṃ: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba/ snang srid dregs pa'i de dpon bzhengs/ mgon nag mhā kā la dang*/ ban chen rdo rje bdud 'dul bcas/ 'dod don= bcol ba'i= hūṃ: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba/ snang srid dregs pa'i de dpon bzhengs/ dmu bdud nag po bkrag med dang*/ mu stegs ku lang nag po bcas/ 'dod don= bcol ba'i= hūṃ: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba/ snang srid dregs pa'i de dpon bzhengs/ srid pa'i lha rab sham po dang*/ gnam sman thob gi bu yug bcas/ 'dod don= bcol ba'i= hūṃ: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba/ snang srid dregs pa'i de dpon bzhengs/ ma sang g.ya' spag skyes gcig ma/ brag batshan srog zan dmar po dang*/ 'dod don= bcol ba'i= hūṃ: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba/ snang srid dregs pa'i de dpon bzhengs// snang srid dregs pa'i ded dpon bzhengs/ srog bdag gnam the'u dkar po dang*/ btsan 'og gang yam shud dmar po bcas/ 'dod yon= bcol ba'i= hūm̐/ bkra shis dam ldan matu che ba/ snang srid dregs pa'i ded dpon bzhengs/ bgegs rgyal bi nā ya ga dang*/ dpal ldan lha mo mgyogs byed bcas/ 'dod don mchod gtor = bcol ba'i= hūṃ: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba/ snag srid dregags pa'i daded dpon bzhengs/ klu bdud nag po go dgu dang*/ klu mo nag mo mdug byed bcas/ 'dodayon macod gtor 'di bzhes la/ bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod*/ maṅga laṃ/ /
